sections.title: Profile Summary
sections.text: Mobile engineer with 7 years building cross-platform apps in React Native and Expo, from prototype to 200K+ users. Focused on performance, Swift and Kotlin native modules, and release pipelines that let teams ship weekly.

items.label: Mobile
items.details: React Native, Expo, Expo Router, EAS Build & Update, Native Modules, Reanimated

items.label: Data & State
items.details: GraphQL, REST, TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux Toolkit, SQLite, WebSockets

items.label: Tooling
items.details: Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, Maestro, GitHub Actions, Firebase, Sentry

items.highlights:
Lead a team of 5 engineers shipping a React Native banking app to 200K+ monthly users with a 99.8% crash-free rate
Cut cold-start time by 30% by moving to the New Architecture and lazy-loading heavy screens
Automated iOS and Android releases with EAS Build and GitHub Actions, cutting release day from 4 hours to 20 min
Introduced Detox and Maestro end-to-end suites that run on every pull request and block regressions before release

Built 3 client apps from scratch in React Native, from design hand-off to App Store and Google Play release
Wrote Swift and Kotlin modules for background location, push notifications and in-app purchases
Added offline-first sync with SQLite and a background queue, so field workers could use the app without signal

Maintained a Swift event-ticketing app and migrated its main flows to React Native
Raised unit test coverage from 20% to 65% on the checkout and payments code

items.name: Trailmate
items.summary: Offline hiking companion with GPS tracking and downloadable maps
items.highlights: Built map tile caching and battery-friendly location tracking in Expo, reaching 4.8 stars across 10K+ installs

items.name: Splitwise Lite
items.summary: Expense splitting for groups, with real-time sync between devices
items.highlights: Designed a conflict-free sync model over WebSockets so edits on two phones never overwrite each other
